blurb: Salty Endeavors offers private and shared fishing charters including offshore, shark fishing, family and kids trips, and sunset cruises. Trips are tailored to experience level and comfort, with all fishing gear, bait, and tackle provided. Guests can keep legal fish except sharks, which are catch and release only.
extraNote: Full refund if cancelled 72 hours before trip; no refund within 72 hours · Full refund if captain cancels due to unsafe weather · 20% deposit required to book, paid by credit or debit card · Remaining balance and tips can be paid with cash · 15–20% gratuity customary · Disruptive or aggressive behavior may result in cancellation without refund · If weather unsafe, captain will reschedule or refund depending on situation and availability · Adventure Marina, 1201-B Miracle Strip Pkwy SE, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548
